steps.hints: ❓ Did you change where the [set sprite image to] block is inside the [on start] container block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How might moving the [set sprite image to] block change how the code runs?


Solution: 

The [play sound] block delays the code after it, which gives the first sprite image time to show before it switches to the second image.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the snake sprite doesn’t switch from one image to another.


Change only the code needed to fix the bug by rearranging the blocks into a different order so you can see the sprite’s image switch from one to the next.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Did you change where the [splash] block is inside the [on start] container block
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓ How might moving the [splash] block change when the splash screen appears?


Solution:

Moving the [splash] block to the top of the code makes it run at the beginning instead of the end.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the splash screen doesn’t appear until the very end, which makes it hard to see what the sprite is saying.


Change only the code needed to fix the bug so the splash screen appears at the beginning!

steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:

❓Which value should you change to move the sprite left or right?

❓Which value should you change to move the sprite up or down?


Solution:

The x value should be between 0 and 160, and the y value should be between 0 and 120 so the sprite appears in the screen.

﻿

Oh no - there are bugs, or problems, in our code! Find and fix the problems by debugging the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code to make the snake sprite appear on the screen!

validationItems.failureText: Check the values of the x and y coordinates in the [set sprite position to] blocks.

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of White Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about using code to create your first projects at Code Ninjas! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: The Journey Begins
badges.description: Use the MakeCode Arcade platform to code a project.

badges.title: Sprite Place at the Sprite Time
badges.description: Create a new sprite and set its position.

badges.title: Painter’s Palette
badges.description: Change the background color of a project.

badges.title: First Words
badges.description: Make a sprite say something on screen.

badges.title: Hearts, Smiles, and Bubbles, Oh My!
badges.description: Add screen effects to a project.

badges.title: Maestro
badges.description: Play a sound in a project.
